cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.32%; weakest is Shale & E&P at +0.03%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.
